meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Use alongside vercel-cli for production-quality deployments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建、测试并验证前端项目，确保高质量交付
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要专业的前端工程实践和自动化质量保障
copy.tagline_en: Build, test, and verify frontend projects for high-quality delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need professional frontend engineering and automated quality assurance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像高级前端工程师一样工作：先理解项目结构，再写代码，然后构建、测试、截图验证，最后部署。它不会说“完成”，直到在真实浏览器中截图确认一切正常。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 开发或修改一个网页项目时触发。它会在构建前检查代码库，构建后运行测试，并在浏览器中截图验证。

say.text: 帮我用 Next.js 建一个博客首页，包含文章列表和导航。
say.note: Claude 会按流程创建项目、写代码、构建并截图验证。

say.text: 给这个 React 组件添加响应式样式，并在平板视图下截图。
部署当前项目到 Vercel，并验证生产环境。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts like a senior frontend engineer: it understands the project, writes code, builds, tests, takes screenshots in a real browser, and deploys. It never says 'done' until visually verified.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to develop or modify a web project. It checks the codebase before building, runs tests after building, and takes screenshots in a browser for verification.

say_en.text: Build a blog homepage with Next.js, including article list and navigation.
say_en.note: Claude will create the project, write code, build, and verify with screenshots.

say_en.text: Add responsive styles to this React component and take a screenshot at tablet view.
Deploy the current project to Vercel and verify the production environment.
